d: For years, Vinicius Junior has fought back against criticism, pressure and scrutiny at Real Madrid. Now, the Brazilian winger is opening up about his own mistakes. From Arsenal transfer links and Real Madrid contract talks to his difficult start to the season, there is more to Vinicius' struggles than what happens on the pitch in La Liga and Champions League. Rupha Ramani explores the pressure of being a global football superstar, the importance of vulnerability and why accountability could be the next big test for Vinicius Junior.
